title: review_request body (sealed)
description: Ask another Obi's owner to review a change. The review counts only for head_sha. Sealed: derived from actions/review_request.schema.json by spec/conformance/generate.mjs, every x-obi-text field a sealed_text (spec/protocol.md section 9.1). Don't edit it by hand.

goal.description: What the change is for, one line.

pr.description: The pull request, when there is one. A change can be a branch only.

base_branch.description: The branch the change goes into.

head_branch.description: The branch that holds the change.

head_sha.description: The commit to review. A review of another commit does not count.

summary.description: A few lines on what changed.

approve_on_host.description: Asks the receiver to post an approving review of head_sha on pull request pr on the code host, as its owner, when its review approves. The receiver does so only under a standing permission its own owner gave (protocol.md section 11, "Approving on the code host"), never because of this field. Needs pr.
